title: Heisei Tensai Bakabon: Susume! Bakabons
native_title: 平成天才バカボン すすめ！バカボンズ
overview: Heisei Tensai Bakabon: Susume! Bakabons is a head-to-head falling-block puzzle game starring the cast of the Heisei Tensai Bakabon anime. Clear colored blocks on your side of the screen, set off chain reactions as the blocks above tumble down, and bury your opponent's field under nuisance blocks. In the one-player story mode, Bakabon's Papa takes on a string of puzzle battles in another world, while the versus mode lets two players pick from nine characters.
